fields.description: Leave BLANK to apply this rule to ALL companies (global rule). Set a company to restrict to that company only. A company-specific rule always takes precedence over a global rule when both match.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Narrows account lookup to a specific root type to prevent accidental matches when two accounts share the same name across root types.
fields.label: Account Root Type Filter

fields.description: Account name WITHOUT the company abbreviation. E.g. 'Bank Charges' not '8801 - Bank Charges - LCD'. Resolved at runtime per company via ERPNext Account lookup.
fields.label: Account Name (Company-Neutral)

fields.description: Strongly recommended. Used to pick the correct account when name alone returns multiple results, and as a secondary lookup if name resolution fails. E.g. '8801'.
fields.label: Account Number (Disambiguator)

fields.description: Comma-separated keywords matched against transaction_description (case-insensitive). For Regex match type, enter a single regex pattern.
fields.label: Keywords / Pattern

fields.description: If the primary account_name_pattern cannot be resolved for a given company, this name is tried next. Handles companies that use slightly different naming conventions.
